raw:
@a1 assumed
  relation "refer to"
  role subject "he"
  role object "the executor"
  basis disambiguation

@s1 stated
  relation "call"
  role subject "the lawyer"
  role object "the executor"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "receive"
  role subject "the executor"
  role object "the summons"
  role source "Buftea Court"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?t
  where match
    relation "have a deadline to respond"
    role subject "the executor"
    role object ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end
